citations.excerpt: Save a reference to tasks passed to this function, to avoid a task disappearing mid-execution. The event loop only keeps weak references to tasks. A task that isn’t referenced elsewhere may get garbage collected at any time, even before it’s done.

claims.text: A strong reference to task should be retained because the event loop only keeps weak references to tasks, and an unreferenced task may be garbage collected mid-execution even before it is done.

receipt.question: If the caller awaiting asyncio.shield(task) is cancelled, is the inner task cancelled by that caller cancellation, what exception does the caller still receive, and why should a strong reference to task be retained?
